summary: A failed captured write left a stale CDC transaction ID after transaction rollback, allowing a subsequent empty COMMIT to emit a spurious CDC record and historically panic without an active MVCC transaction. The fix clears that ID on transaction rollback, establishes a transaction before CDC commit-record writes, and rejects MVCC OpenWrite without a transaction. The proposed reversal removes only the rollback ID reset. Blocked: the added test functions::test_cdc::test_cdc_mvcc_failed_insert_then_empty_commit performs an autocommit SELECT before BEGIN DEFERRED; its successful halt resets the CDC ID independently, masking this defect. No detecting upstream Rust test was established by inspection. No tests were executed.
